+__device__ bool rayBlocked(float3 from, float3 to, uint32_t source, uint32_t destination,
+                           const DeviceTriangle* triangles,
+                           const DeviceOctreeNode* nodes,
+                           const uint32_t* nodeTriangleIndices) {
+    const float3 ray = dsub(to, from);
+    const float rayLength = dnorm(ray);
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    const float3 direction = dmul(ray, 1.0f / rayLength);
+    constexpr int STACK_SIZE = 128;
+    int stack[STACK_SIZE];
+    int stackSize = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+    while (stackSize) {
+        const DeviceOctreeNode& node = nodes[stack[--stackSize]];
+        if (node.triangleCount) {
+            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triangleCount; ++k) {
+                const uint32_t idx = nodeTriangleIndices[node.firstTriangle + k];
+                if (idx == source || idx == destination) continue;
+                const float distance = rayTriangleDistance(from, direction, triangles[idx]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+        } else {
+            // Reverse push order reproduces the host octree's 0..7 traversal.
+            for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+                const int childIndex = node.children[child];
+                if (childIndex >= 0 && rayIntersectsNode(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                    if (stackSize < STACK_SIZE) stack[stackSize++] = childIndex;
+                }
+            }
         }

+void flattenOctree(const Octree& tree, std::vector<DeviceOctreeNode>& nodes,
+                   std::vector<uint32_t>& triangleIndices) {
+    const size_t nodeIndex = nodes.size();
+    DeviceOctreeNode node{};
+    node.center = make_float3(tree.center.x, tree.center.y, tree.center.z);
+    node.halfExtent = make_float3(tree.halfExtent.x, tree.halfExtent.y, tree.halfExtent.z);

+    for (size_t idx : tree.triangleIndices) {

+    }

+            nodes[nodeIndex].children[child] = childIndex;

+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t randomBits(uint64_t counter) {
+    counter += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+    counter = (counter ^ (counter >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    counter = (counter ^ (counter >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
+    return static_cast<uint32_t>((counter ^ (counter >> 31)) >> 32);
+}
+__device__ __forceinline__ float randomUnit(uint64_t counter) {
+    return static_cast<float>(randomBits(counter) >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 randomPoint(const DeviceTriangle& tri,
+                                               uint64_t counter) {
+    float u = randomUnit(counter);
+    float v = randomUnit(counter + 0xd1b54a32d192ed03ULL);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) { u = 1.0f - u; v = 1.0f - v; }
+    return dadd(tri.a, dadd(dmul(dsub(tri.b, tri.a), u),
+                            dmul(dsub(tri.c, tri.a), v)));
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ bool rayIntersectsNode(float3 p1, float3 p2,
+                                                   const DeviceOctreeNode& node) {
+    const float3 d = dmul(dsub(p2, p1), 0.5f);
+    const float3 c = dsub(dadd(p1, d), node.center);
+    const float3 ad = make_float3(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x ||
+        fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y ||
+        fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y*c.z - d.z*c.y) > node.halfExtent.y*ad.z + node.halfExtent.z*ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z*c.x - d.x*c.z) > node.halfExtent.z*ad.x + node.halfExtent.x*ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x*c.y - d.y*c.x) > node.halfExtent.x*ad.y + node.halfExtent.y*ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
 }

+__device__ __forceinline__ float rayTriangleDistance(float3 origin, float3 direction,

+    const float3 e2 = dsub(tri.c, tri.a);

+__device__ bool rayBlocked(float3 from, float3 to, uint32_t source, uint32_t destination,
+                           const DeviceTriangle* triangles,
+                           const DeviceOctreeNode* nodes,
+                           const uint32_t* nodeTriangleIndices) {
+    const float3 ray = dsub(to, from);
+    const float rayLength = dnorm(ray);
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    const float3 direction = dmul(ray, 1.0f / rayLength);
+    constexpr int STACK_SIZE = 128;
+    int stack[STACK_SIZE];
+    int stackSize = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+    while (stackSize) {
+        const DeviceOctreeNode& node = nodes[stack[--stackSize]];
+        if (node.triangleCount) {
+            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triangleCount; ++k) {
+                const uint32_t idx = nodeTriangleIndices[node.firstTriangle + k];
+                if (idx == source || idx == destination) continue;
+                const float distance = rayTriangleDistance(from, direction, triangles[idx]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+        } else {
+            // Reverse push order reproduces the host octree's 0..7 traversal.
+            for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+                const int childIndex = node.children[child];
+                if (childIndex >= 0 && rayIntersectsNode(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                    if (stackSize < STACK_SIZE) stack[stackSize++] = childIndex;
+                }
+            }
         }
     }
+    return false;
 }

+                                 const val_t* kij, const int* tau,

+void flattenOctree(const Octree& tree, std::vector<DeviceOctreeNode>& nodes,
+                   std::vector<uint32_t>& triangleIndices) {
+    const size_t nodeIndex = nodes.size();
+    DeviceOctreeNode node{};
+    node.center = make_float3(tree.center.x, tree.center.y, tree.center.z);
+    node.halfExtent = make_float3(tree.halfExtent.x, tree.halfExtent.y, tree.halfExtent.z);
+    std::fill(std::begin(node.children), std::end(node.children), -1);
+    node.firstTriangle = static_cast<uint32_t>(triangleIndices.size());
+    node.triangleCount = static_cast<uint32_t>(tree.triangleIndices.size());
+    for (size_t idx : tree.triangleIndices) {
+        triangleIndices.push_back(static_cast<uint32_t>(idx));
+    }
+    nodes.push_back(node);
+
+    for (int child = 0; child < 8; ++child) {
+        if (tree.children[child]) {
+            const int childIndex = static_cast<int>(nodes.size());
+            nodes[nodeIndex].children[child] = childIndex;
+            flattenOctree(*tree.children[child], nodes, triangleIndices);
+        }
+    }

+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 dsub(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return make_float3(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z);

+__device__ __forceinline__ float dnorm(float3 a) { return sqrtf(ddot(a, a)); }

+// Counter-based sampling makes every matrix entry deterministic and independent
+// of rank count, GPU scheduling, and OpenMP thread count.
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t randomBits(uint64_t counter) {
+    counter += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+    counter = (counter ^ (counter >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    counter = (counter ^ (counter >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
+    return static_cast<uint32_t>((counter ^ (counter >> 31)) >> 32);
+}
+__device__ __forceinline__ float randomUnit(uint64_t counter) {
+    return static_cast<float>(randomBits(counter) >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 randomPoint(const DeviceTriangle& tri,
+                                               uint64_t counter) {
+    float u = randomUnit(counter);
+    float v = randomUnit(counter + 0xd1b54a32d192ed03ULL);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) { u = 1.0f - u; v = 1.0f - v; }
+    return dadd(tri.a, dadd(dmul(dsub(tri.b, tri.a), u),
+                            dmul(dsub(tri.c, tri.a), v)));
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ bool rayIntersectsNode(float3 p1, float3 p2,
+                                                   const DeviceOctreeNode& node) {
+    const float3 d = dmul(dsub(p2, p1), 0.5f);
+    const float3 c = dsub(dadd(p1, d), node.center);
+    const float3 ad = make_float3(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x ||
+        fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y ||
+        fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y*c.z - d.z*c.y) > node.halfExtent.y*ad.z + node.halfExtent.z*ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z*c.x - d.x*c.z) > node.halfExtent.z*ad.x + node.halfExtent.x*ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x*c.y - d.y*c.x) > node.halfExtent.x*ad.y + node.halfExtent.y*ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
 }

+__device__ bool rayBlocked(float3 from, float3 to, uint32_t source, uint32_t destination,
+                           const DeviceTriangle* triangles,
+                           const DeviceOctreeNode* nodes,
+                           const uint32_t* nodeTriangleIndices) {
+    const float3 ray = dsub(to, from);
+    const float rayLength = dnorm(ray);
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    const float3 direction = dmul(ray, 1.0f / rayLength);
+    constexpr int STACK_SIZE = 128;
+    int stack[STACK_SIZE];
+    int stackSize = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+    while (stackSize) {
+        const DeviceOctreeNode& node = nodes[stack[--stackSize]];
+        if (node.triangleCount) {
+            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triangleCount; ++k) {
+                const uint32_t idx = nodeTriangleIndices[node.firstTriangle + k];
+                if (idx == source || idx == destination) continue;
+                const float distance = rayTriangleDistance(from, direction, triangles[idx]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+        } else {
+            // Reverse push order reproduces the host octree's 0..7 traversal.
+            for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+                const int childIndex = node.children[child];
+                if (childIndex >= 0 && rayIntersectsNode(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                    if (stackSize < STACK_SIZE) stack[stackSize++] = childIndex;
+                }
+            }
         }
     }
+    return false;
 }

+        if (threadIdx.x < offset) sums[threadIdx.x] += sums[threadIdx.x + offset];

+__global__ void simulationKernel(size_t n, size_t localBegin, size_t localCount,
+                                 size_t timestep, size_t timeOn,
+                                 const val_t* kij, const int* tau,
+                                 const val_t* areas, const val_t* radB,
+                                 size_t sourceIndex, val_t reflectivity,
+                                 val_t* current) {
+    const size_t localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localCount) return;
+    const size_t i = localBegin + localI;
+    float partial = ZERO;
+    for (size_t j = threadIdx.x; j < n; j += blockDim.x) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        const size_t matrixIndex = localI * n + j;
+        const int delay = tau[matrixIndex];
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < delay) continue;
+        const float factor = kij[matrixIndex];
+        if (factor <= ZERO) continue;
+        const float sourceRadiosity = radB[(timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay)) * n + j];
+        if (sourceRadiosity > ZERO) {
+            partial += fminf(factor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+        }
+    }
+    extern __shared__ float sums[];

+        if (threadIdx.x < offset) sums[threadIdx.x] += sums[threadIdx.x + offset];
+        __syncthreads();

+        const float emission = (i == sourceIndex && timestep < timeOn) ? ONE : ZERO;
+        current[localI] = reflectivity * sums[0] + emission;
+    }

+__global__ void distanceKernel(size_t n, size_t timesteps, size_t localBegin,
+                               size_t localCount, size_t sourceIndex,
+                               const val_t* radB, val_t* distances) {
+    const size_t localI = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localCount) return;

+        float correlation = ZERO;
+        for (size_t t = shift; t < timesteps; ++t) {
+            correlation += radB[t * n + i] * radB[(t - shift) * n + sourceIndex];
+        }
+        if (correlation > maximum) { maximum = correlation; best = static_cast<int>(shift); }
+    }
+    distances[localI] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<float>(best);

+void initializeAccelerator(const SimulationState& state, AcceleratorState& gpu) {
+    std::vector<DeviceTriangle> triangles(state.numTriangles);
+    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)

+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&gpu.nodeTriangleIndices, state.flatTriangleIndices.size() * sizeof(uint32_t)));

+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(gpu.triangles, triangles.data(), triangles.size() * sizeof(DeviceTriangle), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(gpu.nodes, state.flatNodes.data(), state.flatNodes.size() * sizeof(DeviceOctreeNode), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(gpu.nodeTriangleIndices, state.flatTriangleIndices.data(), state.flatTriangleIndices.size() * sizeof(uint32_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(gpu.areas, state.areas.data(), state.areas.size() * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(gpu.radB, 0, state.numTimesteps * state.numTriangles * sizeof(val_t)));

+void flattenOctree(const Octree& tree, std::vector<DeviceOctreeNode>& nodes,
+                   std::vector<uint32_t>& triangleIndices) {
+    const size_t nodeIndex = nodes.size();
+    DeviceOctreeNode node{};
+    node.center = make_float3(tree.center.x, tree.center.y, tree.center.z);
+    node.halfExtent = make_float3(tree.halfExtent.x, tree.halfExtent.y, tree.halfExtent.z);
+    std::fill(std::begin(node.children), std::end(node.children), -1);
+    node.firstTriangle = static_cast<uint32_t>(triangleIndices.size());
+    node.triangleCount = static_cast<uint32_t>(tree.triangleIndices.size());
+    for (size_t idx : tree.triangleIndices) {
+        triangleIndices.push_back(static_cast<uint32_t>(idx));
+    }
+    nodes.push_back(node);
+
+    for (int child = 0; child < 8; ++child) {
+        if (tree.children[child]) {
+            const int childIndex = static_cast<int>(nodes.size());
+            nodes[nodeIndex].children[child] = childIndex;
+            flattenOctree(*tree.children[child], nodes, triangleIndices);
+        }
+    }

+// Counter-based sampling makes every matrix entry deterministic and independent
+// of rank count, GPU scheduling, and OpenMP thread count.
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t randomBits(uint64_t counter) {
+    counter += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+    counter = (counter ^ (counter >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    counter = (counter ^ (counter >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
+    return static_cast<uint32_t>((counter ^ (counter >> 31)) >> 32);
+}
+__device__ __forceinline__ float randomUnit(uint64_t counter) {
+    return static_cast<float>(randomBits(counter) >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 randomPoint(const DeviceTriangle& tri,
+                                               uint64_t counter) {
+    float u = randomUnit(counter);
+    float v = randomUnit(counter + 0xd1b54a32d192ed03ULL);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) { u = 1.0f - u; v = 1.0f - v; }
+    return dadd(tri.a, dadd(dmul(dsub(tri.b, tri.a), u),
+                            dmul(dsub(tri.c, tri.a), v)));
+}

+__device__ __forceinline__ bool rayIntersectsNode(float3 p1, float3 p2,
+                                                   const DeviceOctreeNode& node) {
+    const float3 d = dmul(dsub(p2, p1), 0.5f);
+    const float3 c = dsub(dadd(p1, d), node.center);
+    const float3 ad = make_float3(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x ||
+        fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y ||
+        fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y*c.z - d.z*c.y) > node.halfExtent.y*ad.z + node.halfExtent.z*ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z*c.x - d.x*c.z) > node.halfExtent.z*ad.x + node.halfExtent.x*ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x*c.y - d.y*c.x) > node.halfExtent.x*ad.y + node.halfExtent.y*ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
 }

+__device__ bool rayBlocked(float3 from, float3 to, uint32_t source, uint32_t destination,
+                           const DeviceTriangle* triangles,
+                           const DeviceOctreeNode* nodes,
+                           const uint32_t* nodeTriangleIndices) {
+    const float3 ray = dsub(to, from);
+    const float rayLength = dnorm(ray);
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    const float3 direction = dmul(ray, 1.0f / rayLength);
+    constexpr int STACK_SIZE = 128;
+    int stack[STACK_SIZE];
+    int stackSize = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+    while (stackSize) {
+        const DeviceOctreeNode& node = nodes[stack[--stackSize]];
+        if (node.triangleCount) {
+            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triangleCount; ++k) {
+                const uint32_t idx = nodeTriangleIndices[node.firstTriangle + k];
+                if (idx == source || idx == destination) continue;
+                const float distance = rayTriangleDistance(from, direction, triangles[idx]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+        } else {
+            // Reverse push order reproduces the host octree's 0..7 traversal.
+            for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+                const int childIndex = node.children[child];
+                if (childIndex >= 0 && rayIntersectsNode(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                    if (stackSize < STACK_SIZE) stack[stackSize++] = childIndex;
+                }
+            }
         }
     }
+    return false;
 }

+void flattenOctree(const Octree& tree, std::vector<DeviceOctreeNode>& nodes,
+                   std::vector<uint32_t>& triangleIndices) {
+    const size_t nodeIndex = nodes.size();
+    DeviceOctreeNode node{};
+    node.center = make_float3(tree.center.x, tree.center.y, tree.center.z);
+    node.halfExtent = make_float3(tree.halfExtent.x, tree.halfExtent.y, tree.halfExtent.z);
+    std::fill(std::begin(node.children), std::end(node.children), -1);
+    node.firstTriangle = static_cast<uint32_t>(triangleIndices.size());
+    node.triangleCount = static_cast<uint32_t>(tree.triangleIndices.size());
+    for (size_t idx : tree.triangleIndices) {
+        triangleIndices.push_back(static_cast<uint32_t>(idx));
+    }
+    nodes.push_back(node);
+
+    for (int child = 0; child < 8; ++child) {
+        if (tree.children[child]) {
+            const int childIndex = static_cast<int>(nodes.size());
+            nodes[nodeIndex].children[child] = childIndex;
+            flattenOctree(*tree.children[child], nodes, triangleIndices);
+        }
+    }

+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 dcross(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return make_float3(a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y,

+// Counter-based sampling makes every matrix entry deterministic and independent
+// of rank count, GPU scheduling, and OpenMP thread count.
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t randomBits(uint64_t counter) {
+    counter += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+    counter = (counter ^ (counter >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    counter = (counter ^ (counter >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
+    return static_cast<uint32_t>((counter ^ (counter >> 31)) >> 32);
+}
+__device__ __forceinline__ float randomUnit(uint64_t counter) {
+    return static_cast<float>(randomBits(counter) >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 randomPoint(const DeviceTriangle& tri,
+                                               uint64_t counter) {
+    float u = randomUnit(counter);
+    float v = randomUnit(counter + 0xd1b54a32d192ed03ULL);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) { u = 1.0f - u; v = 1.0f - v; }
+    return dadd(tri.a, dadd(dmul(dsub(tri.b, tri.a), u),
+                            dmul(dsub(tri.c, tri.a), v)));
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ bool rayIntersectsNode(float3 p1, float3 p2,
+                                                   const DeviceOctreeNode& node) {
+    const float3 d = dmul(dsub(p2, p1), 0.5f);
+    const float3 c = dsub(dadd(p1, d), node.center);
+    const float3 ad = make_float3(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x ||
+        fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y ||
+        fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y*c.z - d.z*c.y) > node.halfExtent.y*ad.z + node.halfExtent.z*ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z*c.x - d.x*c.z) > node.halfExtent.z*ad.x + node.halfExtent.x*ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x*c.y - d.y*c.x) > node.halfExtent.x*ad.y + node.halfExtent.y*ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
 }

+                                                      const DeviceTriangle& tri) {

+__device__ bool rayBlocked(float3 from, float3 to, uint32_t source, uint32_t destination,
+                           const DeviceTriangle* triangles,
+                           const DeviceOctreeNode* nodes,
+                           const uint32_t* nodeTriangleIndices) {
+    const float3 ray = dsub(to, from);
+    const float rayLength = dnorm(ray);
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    const float3 direction = dmul(ray, 1.0f / rayLength);
+    constexpr int STACK_SIZE = 128;
+    int stack[STACK_SIZE];
+    int stackSize = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+    while (stackSize) {
+        const DeviceOctreeNode& node = nodes[stack[--stackSize]];
+        if (node.triangleCount) {
+            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triangleCount; ++k) {
+                const uint32_t idx = nodeTriangleIndices[node.firstTriangle + k];
+                if (idx == source || idx == destination) continue;
+                const float distance = rayTriangleDistance(from, direction, triangles[idx]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+        } else {
+            // Reverse push order reproduces the host octree's 0..7 traversal.
+            for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+                const int childIndex = node.children[child];
+                if (childIndex >= 0 && rayIntersectsNode(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                    if (stackSize < STACK_SIZE) stack[stackSize++] = childIndex;
+                }
+            }
         }
     }
+    return false;
 }

+void flattenOctree(const Octree& tree, std::vector<DeviceOctreeNode>& nodes,
+                   std::vector<uint32_t>& triangleIndices) {
+    const size_t nodeIndex = nodes.size();
+    DeviceOctreeNode node{};
+    node.center = make_float3(tree.center.x, tree.center.y, tree.center.z);
+    node.halfExtent = make_float3(tree.halfExtent.x, tree.halfExtent.y, tree.halfExtent.z);
+    std::fill(std::begin(node.children), std::end(node.children), -1);
+    node.firstTriangle = static_cast<uint32_t>(triangleIndices.size());
+    node.triangleCount = static_cast<uint32_t>(tree.triangleIndices.size());
+    for (size_t idx : tree.triangleIndices) {
+        triangleIndices.push_back(static_cast<uint32_t>(idx));
+    }
+    nodes.push_back(node);
+
+    for (int child = 0; child < 8; ++child) {
+        if (tree.children[child]) {
+            const int childIndex = static_cast<int>(nodes.size());
+            nodes[nodeIndex].children[child] = childIndex;
+            flattenOctree(*tree.children[child], nodes, triangleIndices);
+        }
+    }

+// Counter-based sampling makes every matrix entry deterministic and independent
+// of rank count, GPU scheduling, and OpenMP thread count.
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t randomBits(uint64_t counter) {
+    counter += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+    counter = (counter ^ (counter >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    counter = (counter ^ (counter >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
+    return static_cast<uint32_t>((counter ^ (counter >> 31)) >> 32);
+}
+__device__ __forceinline__ float randomUnit(uint64_t counter) {
+    return static_cast<float>(randomBits(counter) >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 randomPoint(const DeviceTriangle& tri,
+                                               uint64_t counter) {
+    float u = randomUnit(counter);
+    float v = randomUnit(counter + 0xd1b54a32d192ed03ULL);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) { u = 1.0f - u; v = 1.0f - v; }
+    return dadd(tri.a, dadd(dmul(dsub(tri.b, tri.a), u),
+                            dmul(dsub(tri.c, tri.a), v)));
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ bool rayIntersectsNode(float3 p1, float3 p2,
+                                                   const DeviceOctreeNode& node) {
+    const float3 d = dmul(dsub(p2, p1), 0.5f);
+    const float3 c = dsub(dadd(p1, d), node.center);
+    const float3 ad = make_float3(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x ||
+        fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y ||
+        fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y*c.z - d.z*c.y) > node.halfExtent.y*ad.z + node.halfExtent.z*ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z*c.x - d.x*c.z) > node.halfExtent.z*ad.x + node.halfExtent.x*ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x*c.y - d.y*c.x) > node.halfExtent.x*ad.y + node.halfExtent.y*ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
 }

+__device__ bool rayBlocked(float3 from, float3 to, uint32_t source, uint32_t destination,
+                           const DeviceTriangle* triangles,
+                           const DeviceOctreeNode* nodes,
+                           const uint32_t* nodeTriangleIndices) {
+    const float3 ray = dsub(to, from);
+    const float rayLength = dnorm(ray);
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    const float3 direction = dmul(ray, 1.0f / rayLength);
+    constexpr int STACK_SIZE = 128;
+    int stack[STACK_SIZE];
+    int stackSize = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+    while (stackSize) {
+        const DeviceOctreeNode& node = nodes[stack[--stackSize]];
+        if (node.triangleCount) {
+            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triangleCount; ++k) {
+                const uint32_t idx = nodeTriangleIndices[node.firstTriangle + k];
+                if (idx == source || idx == destination) continue;
+                const float distance = rayTriangleDistance(from, direction, triangles[idx]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+        } else {
+            // Reverse push order reproduces the host octree's 0..7 traversal.
+            for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+                const int childIndex = node.children[child];
+                if (childIndex >= 0 && rayIntersectsNode(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                    if (stackSize < STACK_SIZE) stack[stackSize++] = childIndex;
+                }
+            }
         }
     }
+    return false;
 }

+        const float3 pJ = randomPoint(triangles[j], counter + 0xa0761d6478bd642fULL);

+        if (cosineI > ZERO && cosineJ > ZERO) {
+            factor += cosineI * cosineJ / (PI * distanceSquared);
+        }

+__global__ void simulationKernel(size_t n, size_t localBegin, size_t localCount,
+                                 size_t timestep, size_t timeOn,
+                                 const val_t* kij, const int* tau,
+                                 const val_t* areas, const val_t* radB,

+                                 val_t* current) {

+void flattenOctree(const Octree& tree, std::vector<DeviceOctreeNode>& nodes,
+                   std::vector<uint32_t>& triangleIndices) {
+    const size_t nodeIndex = nodes.size();
+    DeviceOctreeNode node{};
+    node.center = make_float3(tree.center.x, tree.center.y, tree.center.z);
+    node.halfExtent = make_float3(tree.halfExtent.x, tree.halfExtent.y, tree.halfExtent.z);
+    std::fill(std::begin(node.children), std::end(node.children), -1);
+    node.firstTriangle = static_cast<uint32_t>(triangleIndices.size());
+    node.triangleCount = static_cast<uint32_t>(tree.triangleIndices.size());
+    for (size_t idx : tree.triangleIndices) {
+        triangleIndices.push_back(static_cast<uint32_t>(idx));
+    }
+    nodes.push_back(node);
+
+    for (int child = 0; child < 8; ++child) {
+        if (tree.children[child]) {
+            const int childIndex = static_cast<int>(nodes.size());
+            nodes[nodeIndex].children[child] = childIndex;
+            flattenOctree(*tree.children[child], nodes, triangleIndices);
+        }
+    }

+__device__ __forceinline__ float dnorm(float3 a) { return sqrtf(ddot(a, a)); }

+// Counter-based sampling makes every matrix entry deterministic and independent
+// of rank count, GPU scheduling, and OpenMP thread count.
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t randomBits(uint64_t counter) {
+    counter += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+    counter = (counter ^ (counter >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    counter = (counter ^ (counter >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
+    return static_cast<uint32_t>((counter ^ (counter >> 31)) >> 32);
+}
+__device__ __forceinline__ float randomUnit(uint64_t counter) {
+    return static_cast<float>(randomBits(counter) >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 randomPoint(const DeviceTriangle& tri,
+                                               uint64_t counter) {
+    float u = randomUnit(counter);
+    float v = randomUnit(counter + 0xd1b54a32d192ed03ULL);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) { u = 1.0f - u; v = 1.0f - v; }
+    return dadd(tri.a, dadd(dmul(dsub(tri.b, tri.a), u),
+                            dmul(dsub(tri.c, tri.a), v)));
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ bool rayIntersectsNode(float3 p1, float3 p2,
+                                                   const DeviceOctreeNode& node) {
+    const float3 d = dmul(dsub(p2, p1), 0.5f);
+    const float3 c = dsub(dadd(p1, d), node.center);
+    const float3 ad = make_float3(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x ||
+        fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y ||
+        fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y*c.z - d.z*c.y) > node.halfExtent.y*ad.z + node.halfExtent.z*ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z*c.x - d.x*c.z) > node.halfExtent.z*ad.x + node.halfExtent.x*ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x*c.y - d.y*c.x) > node.halfExtent.x*ad.y + node.halfExtent.y*ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
 }

+                                                      const DeviceTriangle& tri) {

+    const float3 e2 = dsub(tri.c, tri.a);

+__device__ bool rayBlocked(float3 from, float3 to, uint32_t source, uint32_t destination,
+                           const DeviceTriangle* triangles,
+                           const DeviceOctreeNode* nodes,
+                           const uint32_t* nodeTriangleIndices) {
+    const float3 ray = dsub(to, from);
+    const float rayLength = dnorm(ray);
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    const float3 direction = dmul(ray, 1.0f / rayLength);
+    constexpr int STACK_SIZE = 128;
+    int stack[STACK_SIZE];
+    int stackSize = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+    while (stackSize) {
+        const DeviceOctreeNode& node = nodes[stack[--stackSize]];
+        if (node.triangleCount) {
+            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triangleCount; ++k) {
+                const uint32_t idx = nodeTriangleIndices[node.firstTriangle + k];
+                if (idx == source || idx == destination) continue;
+                const float distance = rayTriangleDistance(from, direction, triangles[idx]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+        } else {
+            // Reverse push order reproduces the host octree's 0..7 traversal.
+            for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+                const int childIndex = node.children[child];
+                if (childIndex >= 0 && rayIntersectsNode(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                    if (stackSize < STACK_SIZE) stack[stackSize++] = childIndex;
+                }
+            }
         }
     }
+    return false;
 }

+__global__ void simulationKernel(size_t n, size_t localBegin, size_t localCount,
+                                 size_t timestep, size_t timeOn,
+                                 const val_t* kij, const int* tau,
+                                 const val_t* areas, const val_t* radB,
+                                 size_t sourceIndex, val_t reflectivity,
+                                 val_t* current) {
+    const size_t localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localCount) return;
+    const size_t i = localBegin + localI;
+    float partial = ZERO;
+    for (size_t j = threadIdx.x; j < n; j += blockDim.x) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        const size_t matrixIndex = localI * n + j;
+        const int delay = tau[matrixIndex];
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < delay) continue;
+        const float factor = kij[matrixIndex];
+        if (factor <= ZERO) continue;
+        const float sourceRadiosity = radB[(timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay)) * n + j];

+        const float emission = (i == sourceIndex && timestep < timeOn) ? ONE : ZERO;
+        current[localI] = reflectivity * sums[0] + emission;
+    }

+__global__ void distanceKernel(size_t n, size_t timesteps, size_t localBegin,
+                               size_t localCount, size_t sourceIndex,
+                               const val_t* radB, val_t* distances) {

+    if (localI >= localCount) return;
+    const size_t i = localBegin + localI;

+        float correlation = ZERO;
+        for (size_t t = shift; t < timesteps; ++t) {
+            correlation += radB[t * n + i] * radB[(t - shift) * n + sourceIndex];
+        }
+        if (correlation > maximum) { maximum = correlation; best = static_cast<int>(shift); }
+    }
+    distances[localI] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<float>(best);

+void initializeAccelerator(const SimulationState& state, AcceleratorState& gpu) {
+    std::vector<DeviceTriangle> triangles(state.numTriangles);
+    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
+    for (ptrdiff_t i = 0; i < static_cast<ptrdiff_t>(state.numTriangles); ++i) {
+        const Triangle& t = state.triangles[static_cast<size_t>(i)];
+        triangles[i] = {make_float3(t.a.x, t.a.y, t.a.z),
+                        make_float3(t.b.x, t.b.y, t.b.z),
+                        make_float3(t.c.x, t.c.y, t.c.z),
+                        make_float3(t._normal.x, t._normal.y, t._normal.z),
+                        make_float3(t.center().x, t.center().y, t.center().z)};
+    }
+    const size_t matrixElements = state.localCount * state.numTriangles;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&gpu.triangles, state.numTriangles * sizeof(DeviceTriangle)));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&gpu.nodes, state.flatNodes.size() * sizeof(DeviceOctreeNode)));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&gpu.nodeTriangleIndices, state.flatTriangleIndices.size() * sizeof(uint32_t)));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&gpu.areas, state.numTriangles * sizeof(val_t)));
+    if (matrixElements) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&gpu.kij, matrixElements * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&gpu.tau, matrixElements * sizeof(int)));
+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&gpu.radB, state.numTimesteps * state.numTriangles * sizeof(val_t)));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&gpu.nonZeroKij, sizeof(unsigned long long)));
+    if (state.localCount) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&gpu.current, state.localCount * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&gpu.distances, state.localCount * sizeof(val_t)));
+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(gpu.triangles, triangles.data(), triangles.size() * sizeof(DeviceTriangle), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(gpu.nodes, state.flatNodes.data(), state.flatNodes.size() * sizeof(DeviceOctreeNode), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(gpu.nodeTriangleIndices, state.flatTriangleIndices.data(), state.flatTriangleIndices.size() * sizeof(uint32_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(gpu.areas, state.areas.data(), state.areas.size() * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(gpu.radB, 0, state.numTimesteps * state.numTriangles * sizeof(val_t)));

+// Counter-based sampling makes every matrix entry deterministic and independent
+// of rank count, GPU scheduling, and OpenMP thread count.
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t randomBits(uint64_t counter) {
+    counter += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+    counter = (counter ^ (counter >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    counter = (counter ^ (counter >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
+    return static_cast<uint32_t>((counter ^ (counter >> 31)) >> 32);

+__device__ __forceinline__ float randomUnit(uint64_t counter) {

+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 randomPoint(const DeviceTriangle& tri,
+                                               uint64_t counter) {
+    float u = randomUnit(counter);
+    float v = randomUnit(counter + 0xd1b54a32d192ed03ULL);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) { u = 1.0f - u; v = 1.0f - v; }
+    return dadd(tri.a, dadd(dmul(dsub(tri.b, tri.a), u),
+                            dmul(dsub(tri.c, tri.a), v)));

+__device__ __forceinline__ bool rayIntersectsNode(float3 p1, float3 p2,
+                                                   const DeviceOctreeNode& node) {
+    const float3 d = dmul(dsub(p2, p1), 0.5f);
+    const float3 c = dsub(dadd(p1, d), node.center);
+    const float3 ad = make_float3(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x ||
+        fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y ||
+        fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y*c.z - d.z*c.y) > node.halfExtent.y*ad.z + node.halfExtent.z*ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z*c.x - d.x*c.z) > node.halfExtent.z*ad.x + node.halfExtent.x*ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x*c.y - d.y*c.x) > node.halfExtent.x*ad.y + node.halfExtent.y*ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;

+__device__ bool rayBlocked(float3 from, float3 to, uint32_t source, uint32_t destination,
+                           const DeviceTriangle* triangles,
+                           const DeviceOctreeNode* nodes,
+                           const uint32_t* nodeTriangleIndices) {
+    const float3 ray = dsub(to, from);
+    const float rayLength = dnorm(ray);
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    const float3 direction = dmul(ray, 1.0f / rayLength);
+    constexpr int STACK_SIZE = 128;
+    int stack[STACK_SIZE];
+    int stackSize = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+    while (stackSize) {
+        const DeviceOctreeNode& node = nodes[stack[--stackSize]];
+        if (node.triangleCount) {
+            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triangleCount; ++k) {
+                const uint32_t idx = nodeTriangleIndices[node.firstTriangle + k];
+                if (idx == source || idx == destination) continue;
+                const float distance = rayTriangleDistance(from, direction, triangles[idx]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+        } else {
+            // Reverse push order reproduces the host octree's 0..7 traversal.
+            for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+                const int childIndex = node.children[child];
+                if (childIndex >= 0 && rayIntersectsNode(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                    if (stackSize < STACK_SIZE) stack[stackSize++] = childIndex;
+                }
+            }
         }
     }
+    return false;

+void flattenOctree(const Octree& tree, std::vector<DeviceOctreeNode>& nodes,
+                   std::vector<uint32_t>& triangleIndices) {
+    const size_t nodeIndex = nodes.size();
+    DeviceOctreeNode node{};

+// of rank count, GPU scheduling, and OpenMP thread count.
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t randomBits(uint64_t counter) {
+    counter += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+    counter = (counter ^ (counter >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    counter = (counter ^ (counter >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
+    return static_cast<uint32_t>((counter ^ (counter >> 31)) >> 32);

+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 randomPoint(const DeviceTriangle& tri,
+                                               uint64_t counter) {
+    float u = randomUnit(counter);
+    float v = randomUnit(counter + 0xd1b54a32d192ed03ULL);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) { u = 1.0f - u; v = 1.0f - v; }

+                            dmul(dsub(tri.c, tri.a), v)));

+__device__ __forceinline__ bool rayIntersectsNode(float3 p1, float3 p2,
+                                                   const DeviceOctreeNode& node) {
+    const float3 d = dmul(dsub(p2, p1), 0.5f);
+    const float3 c = dsub(dadd(p1, d), node.center);
+    const float3 ad = make_float3(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x ||
+        fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y ||
+        fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y*c.z - d.z*c.y) > node.halfExtent.y*ad.z + node.halfExtent.z*ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z*c.x - d.x*c.z) > node.halfExtent.z*ad.x + node.halfExtent.x*ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x*c.y - d.y*c.x) > node.halfExtent.x*ad.y + node.halfExtent.y*ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;

+    int stack[STACK_SIZE];
+    int stackSize = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+    while (stackSize) {
+        const DeviceOctreeNode& node = nodes[stack[--stackSize]];
+        if (node.triangleCount) {
+            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triangleCount; ++k) {
+                const uint32_t idx = nodeTriangleIndices[node.firstTriangle + k];
+                if (idx == source || idx == destination) continue;
+                const float distance = rayTriangleDistance(from, direction, triangles[idx]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+        } else {
+            // Reverse push order reproduces the host octree's 0..7 traversal.
+            for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+                const int childIndex = node.children[child];
+                if (childIndex >= 0 && rayIntersectsNode(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                    if (stackSize < STACK_SIZE) stack[stackSize++] = childIndex;
+                }
+            }
         }
     }
+    return false;
 }

+__global__ void simulationKernel(size_t n, size_t localBegin, size_t localCount,
+                                 size_t timestep, size_t emissionEnd,
+                                 const val_t* kij, const int* tau,
+                                 const val_t* areas, const val_t* radB,
+                                 size_t sourceIndex, val_t reflectivity,
+                                 val_t* current) {

+        current[localI] = reflectivity * sums[0] + emission;

+// Counter-based sampling makes every matrix entry deterministic and independent
+// of rank count, GPU scheduling, and OpenMP thread count.
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t randomBits(uint64_t counter) {
+    counter += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+    counter = (counter ^ (counter >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    counter = (counter ^ (counter >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
+    return static_cast<uint32_t>((counter ^ (counter >> 31)) >> 32);
+}
+__device__ __forceinline__ float randomUnit(uint64_t counter) {
+    return static_cast<float>(randomBits(counter) >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 randomPoint(const DeviceTriangle& tri,
+                                               uint64_t counter) {
+    float u = randomUnit(counter);
+    float v = randomUnit(counter + 0xd1b54a32d192ed03ULL);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) { u = 1.0f - u; v = 1.0f - v; }
+    return dadd(tri.a, dadd(dmul(dsub(tri.b, tri.a), u),
+                            dmul(dsub(tri.c, tri.a), v)));
+}

+__device__ __forceinline__ bool rayIntersectsNode(float3 p1, float3 p2,
+                                                   const DeviceOctreeNode& node) {
+    const float3 d = dmul(dsub(p2, p1), 0.5f);
+    const float3 c = dsub(dadd(p1, d), node.center);
+    const float3 ad = make_float3(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x ||
+        fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y ||
+        fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y*c.z - d.z*c.y) > node.halfExtent.y*ad.z + node.halfExtent.z*ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z*c.x - d.x*c.z) > node.halfExtent.z*ad.x + node.halfExtent.x*ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x*c.y - d.y*c.x) > node.halfExtent.x*ad.y + node.halfExtent.y*ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;

+__device__ bool rayBlocked(float3 from, float3 to, uint32_t source, uint32_t destination,
+                           const DeviceTriangle* triangles,
+                           const DeviceOctreeNode* nodes,
+                           const uint32_t* nodeTriangleIndices) {
+    const float3 ray = dsub(to, from);
+    const float rayLength = dnorm(ray);
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    const float3 direction = dmul(ray, 1.0f / rayLength);
+    constexpr int STACK_SIZE = 128;
+    int stack[STACK_SIZE];
+    int stackSize = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+    while (stackSize) {
+        const DeviceOctreeNode& node = nodes[stack[--stackSize]];
+        if (node.triangleCount) {
+            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triangleCount; ++k) {
+                const uint32_t idx = nodeTriangleIndices[node.firstTriangle + k];
+                if (idx == source || idx == destination) continue;
+                const float distance = rayTriangleDistance(from, direction, triangles[idx]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+        } else {
+            // Reverse push order reproduces the host octree's 0..7 traversal.
+            for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+                const int childIndex = node.children[child];
+                if (childIndex >= 0 && rayIntersectsNode(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                    if (stackSize < STACK_SIZE) stack[stackSize++] = childIndex;
+                }
+            }
         }
     }
+    return false;

+                               const val_t* radB, val_t* distances) {
+    const size_t localI = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localCount) return;
+    const size_t i = localBegin + localI;
+    float maximum = ZERO;
+    int best = 0;
+    for (size_t shift = 0; shift < timesteps; ++shift) {
+        float correlation = ZERO;
+        for (size_t t = shift; t < timesteps; ++t) {
+            correlation += radB[t * n + i] * radB[(t - shift) * n + sourceIndex];
+        }
+        if (correlation > maximum) { maximum = correlation; best = static_cast<int>(shift); }
+    }
+    distances[localI] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<float>(best);

+// Counter-based sampling makes every matrix entry deterministic and independent
+// of rank count, GPU scheduling, and OpenMP thread count.
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t randomBits(uint64_t counter) {
+    counter += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+    counter = (counter ^ (counter >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    counter = (counter ^ (counter >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
+    return static_cast<uint32_t>((counter ^ (counter >> 31)) >> 32);

+__device__ __forceinline__ float randomUnit(uint64_t counter) {
+    return static_cast<float>(randomBits(counter) >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;

+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 randomPoint(const DeviceTriangle& tri,
+                                               uint64_t counter) {
+    float u = randomUnit(counter);
+    float v = randomUnit(counter + 0xd1b54a32d192ed03ULL);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) { u = 1.0f - u; v = 1.0f - v; }
+    return dadd(tri.a, dadd(dmul(dsub(tri.b, tri.a), u),
+                            dmul(dsub(tri.c, tri.a), v)));

+__device__ __forceinline__ bool rayIntersectsNode(float3 p1, float3 p2,
+                                                   const DeviceOctreeNode& node) {
+    const float3 d = dmul(dsub(p2, p1), 0.5f);
+    const float3 c = dsub(dadd(p1, d), node.center);
+    const float3 ad = make_float3(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x ||
+        fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y ||
+        fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y*c.z - d.z*c.y) > node.halfExtent.y*ad.z + node.halfExtent.z*ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z*c.x - d.x*c.z) > node.halfExtent.z*ad.x + node.halfExtent.x*ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x*c.y - d.y*c.x) > node.halfExtent.x*ad.y + node.halfExtent.y*ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;

+__device__ bool rayBlocked(float3 from, float3 to, uint32_t source, uint32_t destination,
+                           const DeviceTriangle* triangles,
+                           const DeviceOctreeNode* nodes,
+                           const uint32_t* nodeTriangleIndices) {
+    const float3 ray = dsub(to, from);
+    const float rayLength = dnorm(ray);
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    const float3 direction = dmul(ray, 1.0f / rayLength);
+    constexpr int STACK_SIZE = 128;
+    int stack[STACK_SIZE];

+    stack[0] = 0;
+    while (stackSize) {
+        const DeviceOctreeNode& node = nodes[stack[--stackSize]];
+        if (node.triangleCount) {
+            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triangleCount; ++k) {
+                const uint32_t idx = nodeTriangleIndices[node.firstTriangle + k];
+                if (idx == source || idx == destination) continue;
+                const float distance = rayTriangleDistance(from, direction, triangles[idx]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+        } else {
+            // Reverse push order reproduces the host octree's 0..7 traversal.
+            for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+                const int childIndex = node.children[child];
+                if (childIndex >= 0 && rayIntersectsNode(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                    if (stackSize < STACK_SIZE) stack[stackSize++] = childIndex;
+                }
+            }
         }
     }
+    return false;

+void flattenOctree(const Octree& tree, std::vector<DeviceOctreeNode>& nodes,
+                   std::vector<uint32_t>& triangleIndices) {
+    const size_t nodeIndex = nodes.size();
+    DeviceOctreeNode node{};
+    node.center = make_float3(tree.center.x, tree.center.y, tree.center.z);
+    node.halfExtent = make_float3(tree.halfExtent.x, tree.halfExtent.y, tree.halfExtent.z);
+    std::fill(std::begin(node.children), std::end(node.children), -1);
+    node.firstTriangle = static_cast<uint32_t>(triangleIndices.size());
+    node.triangleCount = static_cast<uint32_t>(tree.triangleIndices.size());
+    for (size_t idx : tree.triangleIndices) {
+        triangleIndices.push_back(static_cast<uint32_t>(idx));
+    }
+    nodes.push_back(node);
+
+    for (int child = 0; child < 8; ++child) {
+        if (tree.children[child]) {
+            const int childIndex = static_cast<int>(nodes.size());
+            nodes[nodeIndex].children[child] = childIndex;
+            flattenOctree(*tree.children[child], nodes, triangleIndices);
+        }
+    }

+// Counter-based sampling makes every matrix entry deterministic and independent
+// of rank count, GPU scheduling, and OpenMP thread count.
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t randomBits(uint64_t counter) {
+    counter += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+    counter = (counter ^ (counter >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    counter = (counter ^ (counter >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
+    return static_cast<uint32_t>((counter ^ (counter >> 31)) >> 32);

+__device__ __forceinline__ float randomUnit(uint64_t counter) {
+    return static_cast<float>(randomBits(counter) >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 randomPoint(const DeviceTriangle& tri,
+                                               uint64_t counter) {
+    float u = randomUnit(counter);
+    float v = randomUnit(counter + 0xd1b54a32d192ed03ULL);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) { u = 1.0f - u; v = 1.0f - v; }
+    return dadd(tri.a, dadd(dmul(dsub(tri.b, tri.a), u),
+                            dmul(dsub(tri.c, tri.a), v)));
+}

+__device__ __forceinline__ bool rayIntersectsNode(float3 p1, float3 p2,
+                                                   const DeviceOctreeNode& node) {
+    const float3 d = dmul(dsub(p2, p1), 0.5f);
+    const float3 c = dsub(dadd(p1, d), node.center);
+    const float3 ad = make_float3(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x ||
+        fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y ||
+        fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y*c.z - d.z*c.y) > node.halfExtent.y*ad.z + node.halfExtent.z*ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z*c.x - d.x*c.z) > node.halfExtent.z*ad.x + node.halfExtent.x*ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x*c.y - d.y*c.x) > node.halfExtent.x*ad.y + node.halfExtent.y*ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
 }

+__device__ __forceinline__ float rayTriangleDistance(float3 origin, float3 direction,
+                                                      const DeviceTriangle& tri) {
+    const float3 e1 = dsub(tri.b, tri.a);
+    const float3 e2 = dsub(tri.c, tri.a);

+__device__ bool rayBlocked(float3 from, float3 to, uint32_t source, uint32_t destination,
+                           const DeviceTriangle* triangles,
+                           const DeviceOctreeNode* nodes,
+                           const uint32_t* nodeTriangleIndices) {
+    const float3 ray = dsub(to, from);
+    const float rayLength = dnorm(ray);
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    const float3 direction = dmul(ray, 1.0f / rayLength);
+    constexpr int STACK_SIZE = 128;
+    int stack[STACK_SIZE];
+    int stackSize = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+    while (stackSize) {
+        const DeviceOctreeNode& node = nodes[stack[--stackSize]];
+        if (node.triangleCount) {
+            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triangleCount; ++k) {
+                const uint32_t idx = nodeTriangleIndices[node.firstTriangle + k];
+                if (idx == source || idx == destination) continue;
+                const float distance = rayTriangleDistance(from, direction, triangles[idx]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+        } else {
+            // Reverse push order reproduces the host octree's 0..7 traversal.
+            for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+                const int childIndex = node.children[child];
+                if (childIndex >= 0 && rayIntersectsNode(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                    if (stackSize < STACK_SIZE) stack[stackSize++] = childIndex;
+                }
+            }
         }
     }
+    return false;
 }

+void flattenOctree(const Octree& tree, std::vector<DeviceOctreeNode>& nodes,
+                   std::vector<uint32_t>& triangleIndices) {
+    const size_t nodeIndex = nodes.size();
+    DeviceOctreeNode node{};
+    node.center = make_float3(tree.center.x, tree.center.y, tree.center.z);
+    node.halfExtent = make_float3(tree.halfExtent.x, tree.halfExtent.y, tree.halfExtent.z);
+    std::fill(std::begin(node.children), std::end(node.children), -1);
+    node.firstTriangle = static_cast<uint32_t>(triangleIndices.size());
+    node.triangleCount = static_cast<uint32_t>(tree.triangleIndices.size());
+    for (size_t idx : tree.triangleIndices) {
+        triangleIndices.push_back(static_cast<uint32_t>(idx));
+    }
+    nodes.push_back(node);
+
+    for (int child = 0; child < 8; ++child) {
+        if (tree.children[child]) {
+            const int childIndex = static_cast<int>(nodes.size());
+            nodes[nodeIndex].children[child] = childIndex;
+            flattenOctree(*tree.children[child], nodes, triangleIndices);
+        }
+    }

+__device__ __forceinline__ float dnorm(float3 a) { return sqrtf(ddot(a, a)); }

+// Counter-based sampling makes every matrix entry deterministic and independent
+// of rank count, GPU scheduling, and OpenMP thread count.
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t randomBits(uint64_t counter) {
+    counter += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+    counter = (counter ^ (counter >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    counter = (counter ^ (counter >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
+    return static_cast<uint32_t>((counter ^ (counter >> 31)) >> 32);
+}
+__device__ __forceinline__ float randomUnit(uint64_t counter) {
+    return static_cast<float>(randomBits(counter) >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 randomPoint(const DeviceTriangle& tri,
+                                               uint64_t counter) {
+    float u = randomUnit(counter);
+    float v = randomUnit(counter + 0xd1b54a32d192ed03ULL);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) { u = 1.0f - u; v = 1.0f - v; }
+    return dadd(tri.a, dadd(dmul(dsub(tri.b, tri.a), u),
+                            dmul(dsub(tri.c, tri.a), v)));
+}

+__device__ __forceinline__ bool rayIntersectsNode(float3 p1, float3 p2,
+                                                   const DeviceOctreeNode& node) {
+    const float3 d = dmul(dsub(p2, p1), 0.5f);
+    const float3 c = dsub(dadd(p1, d), node.center);
+    const float3 ad = make_float3(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x ||
+        fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y ||
+        fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y*c.z - d.z*c.y) > node.halfExtent.y*ad.z + node.halfExtent.z*ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z*c.x - d.x*c.z) > node.halfExtent.z*ad.x + node.halfExtent.x*ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x*c.y - d.y*c.x) > node.halfExtent.x*ad.y + node.halfExtent.y*ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
 }

+__device__ bool rayBlocked(float3 from, float3 to, uint32_t source, uint32_t destination,
+                           const DeviceTriangle* triangles,
+                           const DeviceOctreeNode* nodes,
+                           const uint32_t* nodeTriangleIndices) {
+    const float3 ray = dsub(to, from);
+    const float rayLength = dnorm(ray);
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    const float3 direction = dmul(ray, 1.0f / rayLength);
+    constexpr int STACK_SIZE = 128;
+    int stack[STACK_SIZE];
+    int stackSize = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+    while (stackSize) {
+        const DeviceOctreeNode& node = nodes[stack[--stackSize]];
+        if (node.triangleCount) {
+            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triangleCount; ++k) {
+                const uint32_t idx = nodeTriangleIndices[node.firstTriangle + k];
+                if (idx == source || idx == destination) continue;
+                const float distance = rayTriangleDistance(from, direction, triangles[idx]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+        } else {
+            // Reverse push order reproduces the host octree's 0..7 traversal.
+            for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+                const int childIndex = node.children[child];
+                if (childIndex >= 0 && rayIntersectsNode(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                    if (stackSize < STACK_SIZE) stack[stackSize++] = childIndex;
+                }
+            }
         }
     }
+    return false;
 }

+__global__ void simulationKernel(size_t n, size_t localBegin, size_t localCount,
+                                 size_t timestep, size_t emissionEnd,
+                                 const val_t* kij, const int* tau,
+                                 const val_t* areas, const val_t* radB,

+        current[localI] = reflectivity * sums[0] + emission;

+void flattenOctree(const Octree& tree, std::vector<DeviceOctreeNode>& nodes,
+                   std::vector<uint32_t>& triangleIndices) {
+    const size_t nodeIndex = nodes.size();
+    DeviceOctreeNode node{};
+    node.center = make_float3(tree.center.x, tree.center.y, tree.center.z);
+    node.halfExtent = make_float3(tree.halfExtent.x, tree.halfExtent.y, tree.halfExtent.z);
+    std::fill(std::begin(node.children), std::end(node.children), -1);
+    node.firstTriangle = static_cast<uint32_t>(triangleIndices.size());
+    node.triangleCount = static_cast<uint32_t>(tree.triangleIndices.size());
+    for (size_t idx : tree.triangleIndices) {
+        triangleIndices.push_back(static_cast<uint32_t>(idx));
+    }
+    nodes.push_back(node);
+
+    for (int child = 0; child < 8; ++child) {
+        if (tree.children[child]) {
+            const int childIndex = static_cast<int>(nodes.size());
+            nodes[nodeIndex].children[child] = childIndex;
+            flattenOctree(*tree.children[child], nodes, triangleIndices);
+        }
+    }
+}

+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 dsub(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return make_float3(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z);
+}
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 dadd(float3 a, float3 b) {

+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 dmul(float3 a, float s) {

+__device__ __forceinline__ float ddot(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;

+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 dcross(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return make_float3(a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y,
+                       a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z,
+                       a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x);
+}
+__device__ __forceinline__ float dnorm(float3 a) { return sqrtf(ddot(a, a)); }
+
+// Counter-based sampling makes every matrix entry deterministic and independent
+// of rank count, GPU scheduling, and OpenMP thread count.
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t randomBits(uint64_t counter) {
+    counter += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+    counter = (counter ^ (counter >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    counter = (counter ^ (counter >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
+    return static_cast<uint32_t>((counter ^ (counter >> 31)) >> 32);
+}
+__device__ __forceinline__ float randomUnit(uint64_t counter) {
+    return static_cast<float>(randomBits(counter) >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 randomPoint(const DeviceTriangle& tri,
+                                               uint64_t counter) {
+    float u = randomUnit(counter);
+    float v = randomUnit(counter + 0xd1b54a32d192ed03ULL);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) { u = 1.0f - u; v = 1.0f - v; }
+    return dadd(tri.a, dadd(dmul(dsub(tri.b, tri.a), u),
+                            dmul(dsub(tri.c, tri.a), v)));
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ bool rayIntersectsNode(float3 p1, float3 p2,
+                                                   const DeviceOctreeNode& node) {
+    const float3 d = dmul(dsub(p2, p1), 0.5f);
+    const float3 c = dsub(dadd(p1, d), node.center);
+    const float3 ad = make_float3(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x ||
+        fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y ||
+        fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y*c.z - d.z*c.y) > node.halfExtent.y*ad.z + node.halfExtent.z*ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z*c.x - d.x*c.z) > node.halfExtent.z*ad.x + node.halfExtent.x*ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x*c.y - d.y*c.x) > node.halfExtent.x*ad.y + node.halfExtent.y*ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
 }

+__device__ __forceinline__ float rayTriangleDistance(float3 origin, float3 direction,
+                                                      const DeviceTriangle& tri) {
+    const float3 e1 = dsub(tri.b, tri.a);
+    const float3 e2 = dsub(tri.c, tri.a);
+    const float3 pvec = dcross(direction, e2);
+    const float det = ddot(e1, pvec);

+__device__ bool rayBlocked(float3 from, float3 to, uint32_t source, uint32_t destination,
+                           const DeviceTriangle* triangles,
+                           const DeviceOctreeNode* nodes,
+                           const uint32_t* nodeTriangleIndices) {
+    const float3 ray = dsub(to, from);
+    const float rayLength = dnorm(ray);
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    const float3 direction = dmul(ray, 1.0f / rayLength);
+    constexpr int STACK_SIZE = 128;
+    int stack[STACK_SIZE];
+    int stackSize = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+    while (stackSize) {
+        const DeviceOctreeNode& node = nodes[stack[--stackSize]];
+        if (node.triangleCount) {
+            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triangleCount; ++k) {
+                const uint32_t idx = nodeTriangleIndices[node.firstTriangle + k];
+                if (idx == source || idx == destination) continue;
+                const float distance = rayTriangleDistance(from, direction, triangles[idx]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+        } else {
+            // Reverse push order reproduces the host octree's 0..7 traversal.
+            for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+                const int childIndex = node.children[child];
+                if (childIndex >= 0 && rayIntersectsNode(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                    if (stackSize < STACK_SIZE) stack[stackSize++] = childIndex;
+                }
+            }
         }
     }
+    return false;
 }

+__global__ void simulationKernel(size_t n, size_t localBegin, size_t localCount,
+                                 size_t timestep, size_t emissionEnd,
+                                 const val_t* kij, const int* tau,
+                                 const val_t* areas, const val_t* radB,
+                                 size_t sourceIndex, val_t reflectivity,
+                                 val_t* current) {
+    const size_t localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localCount) return;
+    const size_t i = localBegin + localI;
+    float partial = ZERO;

+        if (i == j) continue;
+        const size_t matrixIndex = localI * n + j;
+        const int delay = tau[matrixIndex];
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < delay) continue;
+        const float factor = kij[matrixIndex];
+        if (factor <= ZERO) continue;
+        const float sourceRadiosity = radB[(timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay)) * n + j];

+        current[localI] = reflectivity * sums[0] + emission;
+    }

+__global__ void distanceKernel(size_t n, size_t timesteps, size_t localBegin,
+                               size_t localCount, size_t sourceIndex,
+                               const val_t* radB, val_t* distances) {
+    const size_t localI = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localCount) return;
+    const size_t i = localBegin + localI;
+    float maximum = ZERO;
+    int best = 0;
+    for (size_t shift = 0; shift < timesteps; ++shift) {
+        float correlation = ZERO;
+        for (size_t t = shift; t < timesteps; ++t) {
+            correlation += radB[t * n + i] * radB[(t - shift) * n + sourceIndex];
+        }
+        if (correlation > maximum) { maximum = correlation; best = static_cast<int>(shift); }
+    }
+    distances[localI] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<float>(best);

+void initializeAccelerator(const SimulationState& state, AcceleratorState& gpu) {
+    std::vector<DeviceTriangle> triangles(state.numTriangles);
+    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
+    for (ptrdiff_t i = 0; i < static_cast<ptrdiff_t>(state.numTriangles); ++i) {
+        const Triangle& t = state.triangles[static_cast<size_t>(i)];
+        triangles[i] = {make_float3(t.a.x, t.a.y, t.a.z),
+                        make_float3(t.b.x, t.b.y, t.b.z),
+                        make_float3(t.c.x, t.c.y, t.c.z),
+                        make_float3(t._normal.x, t._normal.y, t._normal.z),

+    }

+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&gpu.triangles, state.numTriangles * sizeof(DeviceTriangle)));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&gpu.nodes, state.flatNodes.size() * sizeof(DeviceOctreeNode)));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&gpu.nodeTriangleIndices, state.flatTriangleIndices.size() * sizeof(uint32_t)));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&gpu.areas, state.numTriangles * sizeof(val_t)));
+    if (matrixElements) {

+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&gpu.tau, matrixElements * sizeof(int)));
+    }

codex
Implemented the unconditional hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA version without adding source files or changing the executable name.

Key changes:

- MPI partitions triangle rows across ranks and synchronizes every timestep.
- CUDA accelerates form factors, delays, propagation, and cross-correlation.
- OpenMP parallelizes host mesh preprocessing and accelerator packing.
- Deterministic counter-based sampling ensures rank-count-independent results.
- CMake now requires MPI, OpenMP, and CUDA and targets the native GPU architecture.
- Added CUDA error handling and per-node GPU assignment.

Files changed:

- [roomsim.cpp](/home/llmtest/evals/20260805-120633/roomsim_gpt-5.6-sol-medium_hybrid_r2/roomsim/roomsim.cpp:1)
- [CMakeLists.txt](/home/llmtest/evals/20260805-120633/roomsim_gpt-5.6-sol-medium_hybrid_r2/roomsim/CMakeLists.txt:1)

Verification completed:

- Release build succeeds cleanly.
- Validation passes for 20, 80, and 320 triangles.
- One-rank and two-rank executions produce identical hashes.
- Default 320-triangle, 50-timestep MPI run passes validation.
- Generated build artifacts were removed, leaving only the original files.

+void flattenOctree(const Octree& tree, std::vector<DeviceOctreeNode>& nodes,
+                   std::vector<uint32_t>& triangleIndices) {
+    const size_t nodeIndex = nodes.size();
+    DeviceOctreeNode node{};
+    node.center = make_float3(tree.center.x, tree.center.y, tree.center.z);
+    node.halfExtent = make_float3(tree.halfExtent.x, tree.halfExtent.y, tree.halfExtent.z);

+// Counter-based sampling makes every matrix entry deterministic and independent
+// of rank count, GPU scheduling, and OpenMP thread count.
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t randomBits(uint64_t counter) {
+    counter += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+    counter = (counter ^ (counter >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    counter = (counter ^ (counter >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
+    return static_cast<uint32_t>((counter ^ (counter >> 31)) >> 32);

+__device__ __forceinline__ float randomUnit(uint64_t counter) {
+    return static_cast<float>(randomBits(counter) >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;

+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 randomPoint(const DeviceTriangle& tri,
+                                               uint64_t counter) {
+    float u = randomUnit(counter);
+    float v = randomUnit(counter + 0xd1b54a32d192ed03ULL);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) { u = 1.0f - u; v = 1.0f - v; }
+    return dadd(tri.a, dadd(dmul(dsub(tri.b, tri.a), u),
+                            dmul(dsub(tri.c, tri.a), v)));

+__device__ __forceinline__ bool rayIntersectsNode(float3 p1, float3 p2,
+                                                   const DeviceOctreeNode& node) {
+    const float3 d = dmul(dsub(p2, p1), 0.5f);
+    const float3 c = dsub(dadd(p1, d), node.center);
+    const float3 ad = make_float3(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x ||
+        fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y ||
+        fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y*c.z - d.z*c.y) > node.halfExtent.y*ad.z + node.halfExtent.z*ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z*c.x - d.x*c.z) > node.halfExtent.z*ad.x + node.halfExtent.x*ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x*c.y - d.y*c.x) > node.halfExtent.x*ad.y + node.halfExtent.y*ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;

+__device__ bool rayBlocked(float3 from, float3 to, uint32_t source, uint32_t destination,
+                           const DeviceTriangle* triangles,
+                           const DeviceOctreeNode* nodes,
+                           const uint32_t* nodeTriangleIndices) {
+    const float3 ray = dsub(to, from);
+    const float rayLength = dnorm(ray);
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    const float3 direction = dmul(ray, 1.0f / rayLength);
+    constexpr int STACK_SIZE = 128;
+    int stack[STACK_SIZE];
+    int stackSize = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+    while (stackSize) {
+        const DeviceOctreeNode& node = nodes[stack[--stackSize]];
+        if (node.triangleCount) {
+            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triangleCount; ++k) {
+                const uint32_t idx = nodeTriangleIndices[node.firstTriangle + k];
+                if (idx == source || idx == destination) continue;
+                const float distance = rayTriangleDistance(from, direction, triangles[idx]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+        } else {
+            // Reverse push order reproduces the host octree's 0..7 traversal.
+            for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+                const int childIndex = node.children[child];
+                if (childIndex >= 0 && rayIntersectsNode(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                    if (stackSize < STACK_SIZE) stack[stackSize++] = childIndex;
+                }
+            }
         }
     }
+    return false;
 }

Implemented the unconditional hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA version without adding source files or changing the executable name.

Key changes:

- MPI partitions triangle rows across ranks and synchronizes every timestep.
- CUDA accelerates form factors, delays, propagation, and cross-correlation.
- OpenMP parallelizes host mesh preprocessing and accelerator packing.
- Deterministic counter-based sampling ensures rank-count-independent results.
- CMake now requires MPI, OpenMP, and CUDA and targets the native GPU architecture.
- Added CUDA error handling and per-node GPU assignment.
